approver: Operator decision 2026-11-27; to confirm in PR review
scope: Five Engine unit-test files, exact edits only. test_classifier_limits.py: in test_both_bounds_of_a_limit_read the choice max_labels goes from 2147483647 to 32, and in the over-limit table the labels case sets max_options=2 with max_labels=2. test_routing_core_targets.py: _choice_keys max_options goes from 4 to 3. test_router_optional_re2.py: KEYWORDS_WINDOW and keyword_labels are imported from world.router_decide, and the module docstring names router_decide. test_operation_provenance.py: KEYWORDS_WINDOW is imported from world.router_decide. test_router_spec.py: the definition_json assertion becomes an assertion that the typed definition's JSON dump equals the definition document. No other edit to these files.
reason: The C7 classifier-limits contract bounds a choice row: max_options 1-32 and max_options <= max_labels <= 32. The Engine now enforces those bounds, so test rows that used max_labels above 32, or fewer labels than options, would no longer be usable rows. KEYWORDS moved into world.router_decide, its only production caller, and world.router_keywords was removed. RouterSpec no longer carries a separate definition_json copy; the frozen typed definition is the one source. Each assertion keeps its original intent.
